project.name: SV635N_Control
project.description: Python motor-control backend for SV635N drives connected through an ADLINK PCIe-8332 controller, accepting single-axis and multi-axis continuous motion targets over UDP. It includes a tray application and an independent UDP control client, with retained legacy direct-NIC tools and Unreal Engine integration references.

nodes.name: app.py
nodes.summary: Legacy Tk desktop frontend for direct-NIC pysoem control, device selection, dry runs, single moves, and persistent manual target updates. A single worker owns EtherCAT while queued events update the interface and cooperative stop controls cleanup.

nodes.name: data_folder
nodes.summary: Chooses a writable settings/log directory next to the script or frozen executable, falling back to LOCALAPPDATA after a write probe fails.

nodes.name: App
nodes.summary: Tk desktop controller that manages motor selection, target editors, sliders, and asynchronous legacy EtherCAT operations. It serializes hardware work and consumes queued progress, status, and final reports.

nodes.name: App.__init__
nodes.summary: Initializes the Tk window, persisted adapter settings, single hardware executor, event queue, target state, and polling callbacks.

nodes.name: App._style
nodes.summary: Defines Tk widget typography, colors, selected rows, and distinct run/stop button styles.

nodes.name: App._layout
nodes.summary: Builds adapter discovery, motor selection, motion profiles, target sliders, continuous-enable controls, and log widgets with event bindings.

nodes.name: App.update_summary
nodes.summary: Validates the displayed profile and describes signed single-move duration or immediate relative retargeting behavior.

nodes.name: App.update_buttons
nodes.summary: Derives widget availability from selection, busy state, acknowledged continuous readiness, and cooperative stop state.

nodes.name: App.refresh_adapters
nodes.summary: Enumerates pysoem adapters, selects the saved or first adapter, and updates discovery status and available actions.

nodes.name: App.adapter_changed
nodes.summary: Clears discovered devices, selection, targets, and readiness when the chosen adapter changes, then refreshes the controls.

nodes.name: App.submit
nodes.summary: Schedules one hardware operation on the single worker, replaces its stop token, and reports success or failure through the GUI event queue.

nodes.name: App.scan
nodes.summary: Persists the selected adapter, clears stale device state, and schedules an asynchronous scan that leaves motors disabled.

nodes.name: App.toggle
nodes.summary: Toggles a motor row selection while rejecting unsupported motor parameters and changes during active hardware operations.

nodes.name: App.run_motion
nodes.summary: Validates selected-axis motion parameters and submits a dry run or bounded single move; ready continuous sessions instead receive relative retargets.

nodes.name: App.toggle_continuous
nodes.summary: Creates a validated latest-target queue and starts persistent local control, or requests stop when continuous enable is turned off.

nodes.name: App.sync_slider
nodes.summary: Synchronizes the slider with selected target offsets, optionally recenters its display, and suppresses callbacks during programmatic changes.

nodes.name: App.apply_slider_range
nodes.summary: Validates finite slider center and span, then changes the display range while suppressing target submission.

nodes.name: App.slider_changed
nodes.summary: Applies a finite shared target to selected axes, submitting only changed targets in a ready continuous session and otherwise editing display values.

nodes.name: App.edit_target
nodes.summary: Places an entry editor over a motor target cell and binds commit/cancel events while preserving selection state.

nodes.name: App.queue_relative
nodes.summary: Validates a signed incremental angle, atomically updates all controlled targets relative to the planned position, and refreshes target displays.

nodes.name: App.send_targets
nodes.summary: Commits target edits and submits per-axis absolute offsets, or submits zeros to return to the captured enable origin.

nodes.name: App.stop
nodes.summary: Sets the worker stop event, closes the command queue, cancels target editing, and disables controls pending hardware cleanup.

nodes.name: App.poll
nodes.summary: Consumes queued phase, readiness, command, status, and completion events to update the Tk interface. It guards late readiness after stop and waits for safe completion before closing.

nodes.name: cli.py
nodes.summary: Optional legacy command-line frontend that scans a dedicated EtherCAT adapter and selects motors by unique drive aliases. It verifies communication without enabling by default; --run requests a bounded relative move.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Parses legacy direct-NIC motion options, scans and matches unique drive aliases, installs cooperative Ctrl-C stop, and returns the single-session report with dry-run default.

nodes.name: continuous_control.py
nodes.summary: Legacy persistent local PP controller extending core._Session with a latest-target queue, immediate updates during motion, and encoder rollover tracking. It holds enabled axes while idle and closes command submission before restoring hardware parameters.

nodes.name: run_continuous
nodes.summary: Validates queued axis orders and runs the persistent manual session under the adapter lock, closing the queue regardless of outcome.

nodes.name: _ManualSession
nodes.summary: Persistent manual controller derived from _Session that enables once and accepts the newest immutable target without waiting for previous arrival. It tracks unwrapped encoder motion and bounded histories, then closes the queue during cleanup.

nodes.name: _ManualSession.__init__
nodes.summary: Creates placeholder profile moves for selected axes and initializes bounded trace/command history plus persistent-control report counters.

nodes.name: _ManualSession.motion
nodes.summary: Enables axes once without moving and implements acknowledgement/reset handshakes for newest absolute PP targets. It replaces active targets immediately, tracks unwrapped arrival, and computes per-command timeouts with braking margin.

nodes.name: core.py
nodes.summary: Legacy direct-NIC pysoem controller for discovery and validated CiA402 profile-position motion. Sessions verify drive identity, PDO/DC/watchdog settings, exchange cyclic feedback with bounded recovery, and disable drives before restoring temporary parameters.

nodes.name: read
nodes.summary: Reads an integer from a drive SDO with up to three transport attempts, rejecting empty data and immediately propagating SDO protocol errors.

nodes.name: mapping
nodes.summary: Expands a drive PDO assignment and its referenced mapping objects into the exact list of mapped entries.

nodes.name: displacement
nodes.summary: Computes a signed modular 32-bit encoder displacement across rollover boundaries.

nodes.name: EtherCATController
nodes.summary: Public legacy pysoem facade for adapter discovery, protected device scanning, and bounded move execution. Each operation opens and closes the master under a per-adapter lock.

nodes.name: EtherCATController._discover
nodes.summary: Discovers 1–16 supported SV635N devices in PRE-OP, rejects already-enabled or incompatible drives, and reads identity, gearing, motor, and status data.

nodes.name: EtherCATController.scan
nodes.summary: Locks the adapter, opens a temporary master, discovers devices without enabling, and closes the master in finally.

nodes.name: EtherCATController.execute
nodes.summary: Validates nonempty unique move requests against the discovery snapshot and runs a _Session under the adapter lock.

nodes.name: _Session
nodes.summary: Direct-NIC EtherCAT session implementing drive validation, temporary PP configuration, 1 kHz PDO exchange, and CiA402 move handshakes. Its lifecycle always attempts disable verification and parameter restoration before returning a report.

nodes.name: _Session.__init__
nodes.summary: Allocates the pysoem master and lifecycle flags, indexes selected moves, and prepares report, trace, and optional journal paths.

nodes.name: _Session.setup
nodes.summary: Revalidates the device snapshot, supported motor/PDO/DC/watchdog configuration, and native profile limits before applying temporary drive settings. It journals originals and verifies OP communication while keeping all motors disabled.

nodes.name: _Session.tick
nodes.summary: Stages PDO outputs and performs a paced exchange with bounded WKC recovery using identical controlwords and targets. It validates feedback, drive state, travel, and host lateness, then emits throttled status.

nodes.name: _Session.motion
nodes.summary: Enables selected axes through CiA402 transitions and triggers one relative PP move with acknowledgement, arrival, and disable verification.

nodes.name: _Session.cleanup
nodes.summary: Attempts quick stop and full disable verification, returns the bus to PRE-OP, disables DC synchronization, and restores saved temporary parameters before the save policy.

nodes.name: _Session.run
nodes.summary: Runs setup and optional motion, converts cancellation/faults to reports, always invokes cleanup, and writes trace/journal files after hardware operation.

nodes.name: platform_control.py
nodes.summary: Legacy UDP bridge for three motor-angle targets and a persistent pysoem session, using hello/state and session/seq/enable/targets_deg messages. This older UE protocol is incompatible with the current versioned UDPServer API.

nodes.name: run_three_axis
nodes.summary: Validates exactly three ordered distinct motors, configures the legacy target mailbox and UDP bridge, and runs a locked persistent session with combined feedback callbacks.

nodes.name: CommandInbox
nodes.summary: Thread-safe latest-target mailbox for the legacy three-axis protocol, validating session, sequence, finite bounded targets, and heartbeat freshness. Authenticated disable permanently latches the stop condition even when packets arrive out of order.

nodes.name: CommandInbox.__init__
nodes.summary: Validates target bounds and heartbeat timeout and allocates a unique legacy protocol session, synchronization lock, latest slot, and latched stop event.

nodes.name: CommandInbox.accept
nodes.summary: Authenticates the session and validates sequence, boolean enable, and exactly three finite bounded targets; newer targets replace the slot while disable latches permanently.

nodes.name: UDPBridge
nodes.summary: Background JSON/UDP transport for the legacy UE protocol that binds the first hello sender to the session and publishes state snapshots. Malformed traffic is ignored while accepted command errors and socket failures latch the mailbox stop.

nodes.name: UDPBridge.__enter__
nodes.summary: Binds the UDP socket and starts a daemon receive thread, closing the socket if transport startup fails.

nodes.name: UDPBridge.publish
nodes.summary: Updates synchronized feedback from phase/status/result events, including selected axes and verified disabled state after cleanup.

nodes.name: UDPBridge._receive_loop
nodes.summary: Handles bounded JSON packets from the first hello peer, accepts legacy commands, and sends periodic state responses while latching authenticated-command or transport failures.

nodes.name: _ContinuousSession
nodes.summary: Legacy three-axis _Session subclass that waits for an authenticated target before enabling, then applies latest absolute motor-angle targets. It retains enabled state between updates and enforces heartbeat, drive-state, and configured travel limits.

nodes.name: _ContinuousSession.motion
nodes.summary: Waits for a fresh legacy target before enabling, captures origins, and exchanges immediate absolute three-axis PP setpoints through acknowledgement/reset states.

nodes.name: test_app_continuous.py
nodes.summary: Tk flow regressions using the real local continuous session with an emulated EtherCAT master. They cover target editing, relative updates, live sliders, cancellation, single-move compatibility, and disabling after stop.

nodes.name: AppTests
nodes.summary: Tk integration tests using patched discovery and a fake master to exercise persistent enable, target editing, slider updates, cancellation, and single-move behavior.

nodes.name: AppTests.setUp
nodes.summary: Patches adapter discovery and local control, creates a Tk window with fake devices, and marks three selected motors ready for UI tests.

nodes.name: AppTests.test_edit_targets_relative_origin_and_disable
nodes.summary: Exercises target cell editing, relative updates, return-to-origin, idle enable, and queue clearing plus disable after switching continuous control off.

nodes.name: AppTests.test_single_motion_keeps_its_original_behavior
nodes.summary: Verifies a GUI single move still triggers once per selected axis and finishes with motors disabled and continuous mode inactive.

nodes.name: AppTests.test_live_slider_controls_checked_motors_and_range_changes_do_not_move
nodes.summary: Verifies live slider updates reach only selected axes, display range changes submit no motion, large offsets work, and stop blocks later updates.

nodes.name: AppTests.test_slider_selection_change_and_mixed_targets_do_not_send
nodes.summary: Checks that changing selection or synchronizing mixed target displays does not submit motion, while user slider changes set a common controlled target.

nodes.name: AppTests.test_disabled_slider_only_edits_target
nodes.summary: Checks slider changes while disabled only edit targets, continuous enable begins at zero without commands, and later slider motion succeeds.

nodes.name: test_continuous_control.py
nodes.summary: Hardware-free regressions for local latest-target queues and legacy EtherCAT sessions. They exercise numeric validation, bounded PDO recovery, immediate retargeting, idle enable, cleanup, and accumulated travel across encoder rollovers.

nodes.name: QueueTests
nodes.summary: Validation and projection regressions for immutable latest-target MotionQueue commands, including finite positive profiles, atomic rejection, queue replacement, and closed sessions.

nodes.name: QueueTests.test_profile_has_no_software_upper_or_lower_range
nodes.summary: Accepts finite positive speed/acceleration profiles over very wide magnitudes and rejects zero, negative, boolean, nonfinite, and invalid values.

nodes.name: QueueTests.test_latest_relative_projection_and_atomic_rejection
nodes.summary: Checks readiness gating, immutable command targets, relative projection from planned targets, atomic invalid-command rejection, and single latest-slot replacement.

nodes.name: QueueTests.test_finiteness_latest_slot_and_closed_session
nodes.summary: Rejects malformed targets, verifies repeated relative updates occupy one slot, and ensures closed sessions reject further submission while fresh queues reset state.

nodes.name: CommunicationTests
nodes.summary: PDO recovery regressions using a fake master to ensure incomplete frames do not advance feedback or setpoint edges. They check bounded retries, cooperative stop, recovery timing, and alarm handling.

nodes.name: CommunicationTests.session
nodes.summary: Builds a fake legacy _Session with expected WKC and explicitly seeded axis outputs/feedback for focused PDO exchange tests.

nodes.name: CommunicationTests.test_transient_timeout_and_partial_wkc_retry_without_new_target_edge
nodes.summary: Injects incomplete PDO frames and verifies identical setpoints are retried once, partial feedback is discarded, and motion is not triggered twice.

nodes.name: CommunicationTests.test_persistent_wkc_failure_is_bounded
nodes.summary: Checks persistent receive failure stops within five exchanges and neither updates feedback nor reports successful recovery.

nodes.name: CommunicationTests.test_stop_prevents_retry_and_slow_recovery_still_stops
nodes.summary: Verifies stop requested during receive prevents another exchange and a recovery attempt exceeding the time budget still fails closed.

nodes.name: CommunicationTests.test_alarm_after_recovery_is_not_ignored
nodes.summary: Injects a transient transport failure followed by valid feedback carrying an alarm and verifies the recovered frame still faults the session.

nodes.name: SessionTests
nodes.summary: Persistent manual session regressions for native profile conversion, idle enable, immediate retargeting, fault cleanup, cancellation, and unwrapped multi-revolution feedback.

nodes.name: SessionTests.test_transient_wkc_during_target_ack_continues_and_restores
nodes.summary: Checks a transient WKC failure during continuous acknowledgement recovers without duplicate targets and leaves the bus clean after stop.

nodes.name: SessionTests.assert_clean
nodes.summary: Asserts all drives are disabled, the master is closed, selected-axis parameters are restored, and unselected drives never receive motion targets.

nodes.name: SessionTests.test_high_profile_and_tiny_positive_profile_use_native_parameters
nodes.summary: Verifies large and tiny finite positive motion profiles convert to native counts with a minimum value of one and restore correctly.

nodes.name: SessionTests.test_native_overflow_rejected_before_parameter_writes_or_enable
nodes.summary: Injects native 32-bit profile overflows and verifies validation rejects them before drive writes or enable while closing the master.

nodes.name: SessionTests.test_enable_holds_three_axes_and_idle_stays_enabled
nodes.summary: Verifies enabling holds captured positions, several absolute/relative targets execute with per-axis direction conversion, and an idle continuous session remains enabled until stop.

nodes.name: SessionTests.test_stop_during_first_move_clears_later_commands
nodes.summary: Checks stopping during a started command clears later queued targets, prevents their execution, and restores the drives.

nodes.name: SessionTests.test_updates_while_moving_without_waiting_for_arrival
nodes.summary: Emulates gradual motion and verifies immediate forward/reverse retargeting supersedes older commands without disabling or waiting for arrival.

nodes.name: SessionTests.test_fault_and_ack_timeout_disable_and_restore
nodes.summary: Injects communication, path, enable-state, and acknowledgement faults and checks the continuous session disables and restores selected drives.

nodes.name: SessionTests.test_pre_cancel_never_enables
nodes.summary: Verifies an already-set stop token prevents any motor target or enable-triggered movement and completes cancellation cleanup.

nodes.name: SessionTests.test_unlimited_travel_and_feedback_across_multiple_encoder_rollovers
nodes.summary: Runs hundreds of relative commands across multiple signed encoder rollovers and verifies large positive/negative unwrapped feedback and final return to origin.

nodes.name: test_platform_control.py
nodes.summary: Shared fake EtherCAT slave/master and hardware-free regressions for the legacy three-axis UDP bridge and CiA402 session. Tests cover peer ownership, sequence validation, latched disable, watchdog faults, position wrapping, and parameter restoration.

nodes.name: FakeSlave
nodes.summary: Emulates supported SV635N identity, SDO parameters, PDO mappings, watchdog/DC registers, and CiA402 feedback. Setpoint rising edges update wrapped encoder positions and recorded targets without physical hardware.

nodes.name: FakeSlave.__init__
nodes.summary: Seeds supported identity, initial wrapped positions, native motion parameters, exact PDO maps, and saved originals for deterministic hardware-free tests.

nodes.name: FakeSlave.exchange
nodes.summary: Decodes output PDOs and emulates CiA402 state, acknowledgement, and arrival bits, applying a wrapped target only on a new-setpoint rising edge.

nodes.name: FakeMaster
nodes.summary: Minimal pysoem-compatible fake master holding four FakeSlave instances and expected WKC. It propagates bus states, exchanges simulated PDOs, and records close state for cleanup assertions.

nodes.name: InboxTests
nodes.summary: Legacy UDP mailbox and bridge regressions for ordering, target validation, session rejection, heartbeat expiry, first-peer ownership, and permanent disable.

nodes.name: InboxTests.test_validation_and_stale_session
nodes.summary: Rejects stale sessions and malformed, nonfinite, boolean, oversized, or out-of-bound three-axis targets without publishing a latest command.

nodes.name: InboxTests.test_udp_handshake_peer_and_fault
nodes.summary: Uses loopback sockets to verify hello establishes the peer, stranger commands are ignored, valid commands update the inbox, and invalid owned commands latch stop.

nodes.name: SessionTests
nodes.summary: Legacy three-axis and single-move regression suite verifying latched stop, watchdog faults, direction/wrapping, cleanup, and restoration with an emulated master.

nodes.name: SessionTests.test_watchdog_wkc_and_limit_fail_closed
nodes.summary: Injects heartbeat expiry, WKC failure, configured travel violation, and local stop into the legacy three-axis session and verifies disable, restoration, and master close.

nodes.name: SessionTests.test_persistent_motion_wrap_direction_stop_and_restore
nodes.summary: Verifies persistent three-axis targets honor per-axis direction and encoder wrapping, unchanged heartbeat targets do not restart motion, and stop restores parameters without intermediate disable cycles.

nodes.name: SessionTests.test_pre_cancel_never_enables
nodes.summary: Verifies an already-set stop token prevents any motor target or enable-triggered movement and completes cancellation cleanup.

nodes.name: __main__.py
nodes.summary: Launches the independent Tk UDP control client with endpoint configuration, command-line overrides, rotating logs, and UI-thread cleanup. It imports no controller or hardware library.

nodes.name: load_config
nodes.summary: Reads and validates endpoint/auth settings from JSON while ignoring unrelated backend configuration fields. Defaults to localhost port 5005 and an empty authentication key.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Parses client launch arguments, initializes rotating logs, starts the Tk debug window, and reports failures using a Windows message box. Closes the SDK and destroys Tk objects on the UI thread.

nodes.name: client.py
nodes.summary: Implements the standard-library-only, thread-safe UDP motor SDK with retried ACK requests, owner sessions, per-run targets, independent heartbeats, and telemetry ordering. Separates request IDs, control_seq, shared target/heartbeat seq, run_id, and state_serial/server_id.

nodes.name: UDPError
nodes.summary: Signals rejected, failed, or unacknowledged SDK requests and state-wait failures.

nodes.name: MotorClient
nodes.summary: Owns the UDP socket, request correlation, session/run identity, feedback state, receiver thread, and independent heartbeat thread. Exposes a portable motor API with retries and best-effort shutdown.

nodes.name: MotorClient.__init__
nodes.summary: Validates the heartbeat interval and initializes the UDP socket, synchronized state, pending-request map, and receiver/heartbeat daemon threads.

nodes.name: MotorClient._receive
nodes.summary: Receives packets only from the configured peer, correlates ACKs to pending IDs, and accepts newer telemetry only from the current server_id. Ignores stale state_serial values and records socket failures.

nodes.name: MotorClient.request
nodes.summary: Creates one UUID request ID and encoded packet per operation, then resends that exact datagram until an ACK arrives or retries expire. Adds session/auth data and advances control_seq for adapters, scan, enable, and release.

nodes.name: MotorClient.hello
nodes.summary: Serializes ownership handshakes and updates server/session identity from the ACK. A changed server refreshes feedback ordering, while a new owner session resets run state and synchronizes control_seq.

nodes.name: MotorClient.wait_for
nodes.summary: Polls status until an allowed phase appears, raises the backend fault message immediately, and fails when its deadline expires.

nodes.name: MotorClient.close
nodes.summary: Attempts to disable an active run, wait for cleanup, and release ownership before closing the socket and joining both background threads. Failed requests leave the server watchdog responsible for stopping the run.

nodes.name: debug_ui.py
nodes.summary: Provides a Tk debug panel that selects devices, scans the controller, enables runs, streams coalesced slider targets, and displays axis and endpoint-limit feedback through the UDP SDK. A dedicated executor submits stop requests independently of ordinary ACK waits.

nodes.name: DebugWindow
nodes.summary: Coordinates the Tk controls, motor selection, queued SDK work, dedicated stop executor, and feedback rendering. All controller actions are sent through MotorClient.

nodes.name: DebugWindow.__init__
nodes.summary: Creates the UDP SDK, ordinary and stop executors, event queue, and Tk controls for card selection, per-axis feedback, run parameters, and slider offsets. Registers a 20 ms UI polling loop.

nodes.name: DebugWindow.stop
nodes.summary: Drops any unsent target and schedules disable on the dedicated stop executor when this client owns an active run. Returns worker results/errors to the UI event queue.

nodes.name: DebugWindow.task
nodes.summary: Allows one ordinary SDK operation at a time and executes it outside the Tk thread. Sends its labeled result or exception back through the event queue.

nodes.name: DebugWindow.enable
nodes.summary: Requires acknowledged run conditions and selected motors, parses RPM/acceleration values, and queues an SDK enable call for sorted selected axis orders.

nodes.name: DebugWindow.set_range
nodes.summary: Validates a finite slider center and positive span, then updates display bounds while suppressing target changes during synchronization.

nodes.name: DebugWindow.render
nodes.summary: Updates axis positions, enable/fault state, digital inputs, and both endpoint-limit indicators from feedback. Enables controls according to ownership, backend phase, and matching run_id, clearing unsent targets when motion control is unavailable.

nodes.name: DebugWindow.poll
nodes.summary: Drains worker events, displays errors, refreshes controller choices, renders status replies, and marks limit feedback unknown after one second without updates. Coalesces slider targets and otherwise sends hello every 200 ms to refresh observation/idle ownership leases.

nodes.name: example_client.py
nodes.summary: Offers a command-line SDK example that queries status by default and uses --move to scan, enable selected axes, and send sinusoidal offsets at approximately 60 Hz. It disables the run in a finally block.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Queries backend status or, with --move, claims ownership and sends sinusoidal targets for the requested duration. Waits for scan/enable phases and guarantees a disable request after motion.

nodes.name: wire.py
nodes.summary: Provides compact UTF-8 JSON encoding and strict datagram decoding for portable clients. Decoding rejects oversized packets, non-object JSON, and non-finite constants; the SDK currently uses encode and handles received JSON itself.

nodes.name: encode
nodes.summary: Serializes a packet as compact UTF-8 JSON and disallows NaN and Infinity.

nodes.name: decode
nodes.summary: Rejects datagrams over 8192 bytes, non-finite JSON constants, and JSON values that are not objects. Returns the parsed packet dictionary.

nodes.name: test_udp_protocol.py
nodes.summary: Verifies UDP request deduplication, control-sequence replay protection, ownership and authentication, run isolation, leases, malformed packets, lost-ACK retries, and server-restart feedback filtering. Uses a mocked motor service and loopback sockets.

nodes.name: ProtocolTests
nodes.summary: Tests server protocol behavior using a mock service and real loopback UDP for retry and restart scenarios.

nodes.name: ProtocolTests.setUp
nodes.summary: Creates a mocked idle motor service and ephemeral UDP server, then obtains an owner session using a direct hello packet.

nodes.name: ProtocolTests.test_owner_auth_and_disable_run_isolation
nodes.summary: Checks exclusive ownership, read-only hello, stale-run disable rejection, matching-run stop, and authentication requirements for a non-loopback bind.

nodes.name: ProtocolTests.test_release_retry_and_idle_lease_expiry
nodes.summary: Checks idempotent release retries, fresh sessions after release, and replacement ownership after an idle lease expires. Rejects commands carrying the expired token.

nodes.name: ProtocolTests.test_real_udp_lost_ack_retry_executes_enable_once
nodes.summary: Drops the first enable ACK on a real loopback socket and confirms MotorClient retries successfully while the service executes enable exactly once.

nodes.name: ProtocolTests.test_client_reconnects_after_restart_and_ignores_old_server_feedback
nodes.summary: Restarts the UDP server on the same port and verifies the client obtains new server/session identities. Injects old-server telemetry with a high state_serial and confirms it cannot replace current feedback.

nodes.name: test_udp_service.py
nodes.summary: Exercises the UDP SDK, server, and motor service together with an injected fake EtherCAT controller. Covers selected-axis runs, unlimited offsets, heartbeat watchdogs, independent target ordering, fault recovery, and a portable client subprocess.

nodes.name: ServiceTests
nodes.summary: Builds a real UDP client/server/service stack over FakeMaster-backed EtherCAT controllers and tests complete run lifecycles without hardware.

nodes.name: ServiceTests.setUp
nodes.summary: Injects FakeMaster-backed EtherCAT controllers into MotorService, starts an ephemeral UDP server, and connects an owner MotorClient.

nodes.name: ServiceTests.test_multiple_runs_selection_unlimited_target_and_no_retrigger
nodes.summary: Checks selected-axis large offsets, deduplication of unchanged targets, verified disable completion, distinct run IDs after re-enable, and rejection of a stale-run disable.

nodes.name: ServiceTests.test_heartbeat_timeout_rejects_late_packets
nodes.summary: Suppresses client heartbeats and verifies the watchdog stops the run, rejects late targets, and reports all axes disabled with the heartbeat timeout reason.

nodes.name: ServiceTests.test_reorder_heartbeats_do_not_supersede_targets_or_renew_duplicates
nodes.summary: Checks that newer heartbeat seq values do not supersede target ordering, older targets are rejected, and duplicate heartbeats do not renew the lease. An already expired watchdog rejects subsequent heartbeats.

nodes.name: ServiceTests.test_socket_failure_and_fault_require_rescan
nodes.summary: Injects a fake EtherCAT communication failure and verifies queue closure, fault state, and enable rejection until rescan. Then closes the UDP server and verifies the recovered run stops with all axes disabled.

nodes.name: ServiceTests.test_separate_portable_client_process_controls_backend_only_over_udp
nodes.summary: Copies only the portable Python client package into a temporary directory and runs it in a separate interpreter with site imports disabled. Checks UDP scan/enable/target/disable behavior and selected-axis results.

nodes.name: aps_backend.py
nodes.summary: Owns the ADLINK PCIe-8332 APS DLL lifecycle and validates SV635N topology, units, direction and endpoint sensors. Runs card-generated point-to-point motion with preflight checks, continuous feedback, directional limit escape, and verified stop/disable/parameter restoration.

nodes.name: validate_options
nodes.summary: Normalizes APS defaults and rejects unknown keys, invalid card IDs/timing/units and malformed or overlapping extension/retraction sensor mappings.

nodes.name: AsyncCall
nodes.summary: ctypes layout for an APS asynchronous call handle, return status and mode; used in the point-to-point ABI signature.

nodes.name: ModuleInfo
nodes.summary: ctypes mirror of the APS field-bus module structure, including device identity, axis mapping and IO module arrays.

nodes.name: APSLibrary
nodes.summary: Loads the matching-bitness APS DLL from SDK locations, assigns ctypes ABI signatures and turns negative return codes or invalid numeric feedback into ControlError.

nodes.name: APSLibrary.__init__
nodes.summary: Loads a bitness-matched APS DLL and binds every required function signature, reporting missing SDK libraries and exports.

nodes.name: APSLibrary.call
nodes.summary: Invokes a bound APS function and raises a diagnostic error on a negative return, with an EtherCAT configuration hint for -4012.

nodes.name: APSLibrary.value
nodes.summary: Reads a typed APS output parameter and rejects nonfinite double feedback.

nodes.name: APSDevice
nodes.summary: Immutable extension of Device with APS axis/slave identity, position units and configured extension/retraction sensor directions.

nodes.name: PCIe8332Controller
nodes.summary: Owns one configured PCIe-8332 card on one hardware thread, validates SV635N devices, executes continuous card trajectories and restores owned hardware state during cleanup.

nodes.name: PCIe8332Controller.__init__
nodes.summary: Validates card configuration and prepares a lazy APS factory, lifecycle flags, saved parameters and hardware-thread ownership.

nodes.name: PCIe8332Controller._open
nodes.summary: Acquires APS exclusivity, initializes the expected card, safely adopts or starts the bus, saves board settings and restores partial initialization on failure.

nodes.name: PCIe8332Controller._configure_unwired_emg
nodes.summary: For explicitly unwired emergency input only, verifies all servos off, saves and flips common EMG polarity and confirms the input releases.

nodes.name: PCIe8332Controller._devices
nodes.summary: Enumerates mapped single-axis SV635N slaves, checks online/servo-off state and SDO identity/gearing, and validates unit overrides and opposite endpoint DI assignments.

nodes.name: PCIe8332Controller.scan
nodes.summary: Opens the configured APS lifecycle and returns freshly validated device topology without enabling motors.

nodes.name: PCIe8332Controller.read_inputs
nodes.summary: Reads 32-bit 60FD cyclic PDO feedback and native IO limits into per-device endpoint states, preserving unavailable feedback as unknown.

nodes.name: PCIe8332Controller.close
nodes.summary: Stops the owned field bus, restores saved board parameters, closes APS and releases the exclusivity context while accumulating cleanup errors.

nodes.name: PCIe8332Controller.run_continuous

nodes.name: motor_service.py

Injected controllers can use the legacy direct-NIC fallback through lazy imports.

nodes.name: MotorService.scan

nodes.name: MotorService._scan
nodes.summary: Scans and reads sensors on the hardware executor; publishes devices on success or closes hardware and latches fault on failure.

nodes.summary: Processes hardware readiness, axis/sensor telemetry, blocked-limit messages and phase updates under the service lock.

nodes.name: MotorService._run
nodes.summary: Runs native or injected legacy continuous control, publishes a bounded result and transitions to idle only after an intentional verified clean stop; otherwise latches fault.

nodes.name: MotorService.command
nodes.summary: Validates run and per-channel sequence, refuses expired heartbeats or unsafe endpoint targets, submits changed targets and refreshes heartbeat only for accepted requests.

nodes.name: MotorService.stop

nodes.name: MotorService._watchdog

nodes.name: MotorService._poll_inputs

nodes.name: MotorService.close
nodes.summary: Stops monitoring and motion, queues hardware lifecycle closure and waits for the executor so stop/disable/restoration cannot be abandoned.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with README.md to identify the current PCIe-8332 UDP backend, its independent client and the hardware-free regression suite. The repository also retains direct-NIC tools and an older Unreal protocol, so the tour first follows the current backend before comparing those separate paths.

tour.title: Deployment And Configuration
tour.description: Following the README, the backend guide and example configuration show which settings belong to the server: endpoint, authentication, heartbeat timeout, APS card options and endpoint sensors. The Windows launchers select tray or headless operation, while requirements.txt supplies the tray dependencies. This establishes the operating environment before tracing startup code.

tour.title: Backend Startup And Shutdown
tour.description: backend.py is the current application entry point: it validates the settings from the previous step, configures rotating logs and starts MotorService with UDPServer. Tray mode launches the control interface as a separate process, while headless mode hosts the same service without that interface. Both routes close the server and hardware owner when the process exits.

tour.title: Shared Motion Vocabulary
tour.description: Before examining startup's two services, read control_common.py for the shared Device, Move, MotionCommand and error types. Its validation and adapter exclusivity support both current and legacy controllers, and its locked queue replaces pending targets while preserving accumulated relative intent. These types explain what the network layer requests and what the hardware worker consumes.
tour.languageLesson: Frozen dataclasses represent immutable records, and a context manager places lock release in a finally block so errors cannot strand hardware ownership.

tour.title: Versioned UDP Contract
tour.description: The v1 protocol translates the motion vocabulary into explicit hello, scan, enable, target, heartbeat, disable and release requests. UDPServer enforces an exclusive session, authentication, bounded request deduplication and increasing control sequences, while run IDs isolate target and heartbeat traffic from previous runs. The protocol guide also explains snapshot ordering, so retries and reordered datagrams can be understood separately from physical motion.

tour.title: Service Worker And Watchdog
tour.description: MotorService receives the validated requests from UDPServer and coordinates scanning, enabling, active targets, stopping and fault state. A single-worker executor owns hardware access; the watchdog requests a stop after heartbeat expiry and schedules idle sensor reads through that same worker. Status snapshots cross the thread boundary as copied data, and failures remain latched until an explicit scan.
tour.languageLesson: ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1) serializes queued hardware operations; locks protect shared service state while events communicate cooperative stop requests.

tour.title: APS Card And Topology
tour.description: The service's default hardware owner is PCIe8332Controller in aps_backend.py. Its ctypes bindings load the APS DLL and validate the SV635N topology, axis mapping, position units and motor direction before enabling selected axes. The card generates the point-to-point trajectories, making Python responsible for validated commands and feedback rather than EtherCAT cycle generation.
tour.languageLesson: ctypes structures and explicit argument/return types mirror the native SDK ABI; matching pointer sizes and data layouts matters before any hardware call.

tour.title: Endpoint Protection And Cleanup
tour.description: Building on the validated axes, the APS controller interprets configured extension and retraction feedback and permits movement away from an active endpoint while rejecting movement toward it. Missing feedback and conflicting endpoints participate in preflight and runtime fault checks, and a stopped target does not resume automatically when a sensor clears. Cleanup stops owned axes, verifies servo disable and restores temporary parameters before MotorService declares a clean stop.

tour.title: Independent Client SDK
tour.description: With server behavior established, MotorClient packages the same v1 contract into a standard-library SDK that imports no hardware libraries. It manages retried ACK requests, session ownership, run-scoped targets, independent heartbeats and telemetry ordering. The wire helpers and command-line example show how an external program uses that boundary and disables its run during cleanup.

tour.title: UDP Control Interface
tour.description: The Tk debug interface builds on MotorClient to select devices, scan, enable and stream coalesced slider targets. It renders axis and endpoint feedback and uses a dedicated executor for stop requests so an ordinary ACK wait cannot hold them up. Its separate entry point and endpoint-only configuration preserve the deployment boundary introduced by the backend tray launcher.

tour.title: Hardware-Free Regression Evidence
tour.description: The test suites verify the complete path just traced using fake APS APIs, injected EtherCAT controllers and loopback UDP. They exercise endpoint protection, stop and restoration, replay and retry handling, heartbeat expiry, UI feedback and single-thread hardware ownership. Deployment tests also check that the client runs without backend packages and that the backend imports without frontend packages.

tour.title: Legacy Paths And Compatibility
tour.description: Finally, compare the current architecture with core.py and app.py, which retain direct-NIC pysoem discovery and local CiA402 motion. platform_control.py hosts the older three-axis bridge used by the Unreal component and requires explicit bridge startup. Its motor-angle messages are incompatible with the current v1 UDP RPC backend, so the Unreal reference cannot be pointed at that server unchanged.
